title: K-flat computation of a realized scalar pullback comparison
statement: Let a:Λ→Λ′ be a map of commutative condensed coefficient rings, f:X→Y a scheme morphism, sX and sY normalized section scalar comparisons, and b an internal scalar/pullback isomorphism satisfying PullNormalized, all as in [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons] and [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-pullback-comparison-data]. Supply an ordinary restriction/pushforward isomorphism r that is identity on sections, an ordinary scalar/pullback isomorphism c whose inverse has conjugate r under the specified composite adjunctions, and a derived scalar/pullback isomorphism d satisfying the realization equation for b. Then for every flat-term K-flat section cochain complex P the d computation equation in SectionPullNormalized holds with the supplied c. This conclusion asserts only the representative equation and constructs none of r, c, d.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 0D6D and 07A6; lemma-derived-base-change and lemma-derived-pullback-composition, with the representative computation step of internal scalar/pullback normalization.

proof.text: Extend each endpoint scalar computation equation to every internal complex by incoming flat-term K-flat resolutions and naturality.
Identify the ordinary scalar/geometric square with the given c using the ordinary mate compatibility equation. Apply the termwise functor to obtain its cochain equation.
Paste the endpoint scalar equations with the two geometric representative equations. Naturality of the middle scalar or geometric computation map gives the two composite computation equations.

Evaluate PullNormalized at the homotopy quotient of P. Substitute this internal equality between the two pasted computation paths. Use naturality of the localization factor maps, the ordinary cochain equality, and the supplied realization of d. Cancel the scalar and geometric comparison isomorphisms.

The resulting equality of natural transformations on section complexes holds after precomposition with the termwise section equivalence. Faithfulness of this precomposition gives equality on every section complex. The original flat-term K-flat hypotheses are therefore unnecessary for this final calculation.

proof_origin.place: W8: extend endpoint computation equations by resolving naturality; paste universal computation squares before transporting through the termwise equivalence. No pullback K-flatness preservation is needed for this route.

theorem section_pull_computation_of_realization (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (sX : SectionScalarComparison a X) (sY : SectionScalarComparison a Y)
    (hX : SectionScalarNormalized a X sX) (hY : SectionScalarNormalized a Y sY)
    (b : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X)
    (normalized : PullNormalized a f b)
    (r : ModuleRingedComparison.pushforward Λ' f ⋙
      SheafOfModules.scalarRestriction.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (coefficientMap a Y)) ≅
        SheafOfModules.scalarRestriction.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficientMap a X)) ⋙
            ModuleRingedComparison.pushforward Λ f)
    (identity_on_sections : (∀ (N : ModuleRingedComparison.modules Λ' X) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((ModuleRingedComparison.pushforward Λ' f).obj N).val.obj U),
    (r.hom.app N).val.app U x = x))
    (c : sY.pair.extension ⋙ ModuleRingedComparison.pullback Λ' f ≅
    ModuleRingedComparison.pullback Λ f ⋙ sX.pair.extension)
    (conjugate : conjugateEquiv
      (sY.pair.ordinaryAdjunction.comp (ModuleRingedComparison.adjunction Λ' f))
      ((ModuleRingedComparison.adjunction Λ f).comp sX.pair.ordinaryAdjunction) c.inv = r.hom)
    (d : sY.pair.derived ⋙ ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullback Λ' f ≅
    ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ sX.pair.derived)
    (realization : ∀ M : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ Y),
    (ModuleRingedComparison.derivedEquivalence Λ' X).functor.map (b.hom.app M) ≫
        sX.derived.hom.app ((L Λ f).obj M) ≫
        sX.pair.derived.map ((scalarSectionPullComparison Λ f).hom.app M) =
      (scalarSectionPullComparison Λ' f).hom.app ((D a Y).obj M) ≫
        (ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullback Λ' f).map (sY.derived.hom.app M) ≫
        d.hom.app ((ModuleRingedComparison.derivedEquivalence Λ Y).functor.obj M)) :
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.modules Λ Y) ℤ),
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := ModuleRingedComparison.ring Λ Y) P →
    (∀ n : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
      (R := ModuleRingedComparison.ring Λ Y) (P.X n)) →
    d.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        sX.pair.derived.map
          ((ModuleRingedComparison.pullback Λ f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
        SheafOfModules.scalarPairComplexComparison.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          sX.pair.extension sX.pair.extension_additive
          sX.pair.derived sX.pair.counit
          (((ModuleRingedComparison.pullback Λ f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
      (ModuleRingedComparison.derivedPullback Λ' f).map
        (SheafOfModules.scalarPairComplexComparison.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          sY.pair.extension sY.pair.extension_additive
          sY.pair.derived sY.pair.counit P) ≫
        (ModuleRingedComparison.pullback Λ' f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          ((SheafOfModules.scalarComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
              sY.pair.extension sY.pair.extension_additive).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso c (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
